usage: 半 means 'half' and is used to describe half of something in amount, size, quantity, or portion.
You can use 半 before measure words and nouns, such as 半個蘋果 (half an apple) or 半斤菜 (half a catty of vegetables).
半 is often used when you want part of something instead of the whole.
It is common in shopping, cooking, and everyday conversation.
半 can also be used in expressions like 一半 to mean 'one half'.
